title: Fall Raku Clay Workshop
bring: bisqued pots or prepared clay (the workshop includes clay)
commitment: Oct 31, 9am-5pm (Nov 1 rain date) for clay work; Nov 14 (Nov 15 rain date) for firing
summary: Steve Liggett leads a two-part raku workshop: form clay on Oct 31, fire on Nov 14. Cost is $210 including 10 lbs. of clay, with space limited and early enrollment encouraged.
how_to_join: Sign up through the C.A.T. website
source_quote: FALL 26 Raku Firing Workshop with Steve Liggett. Oct 31, 9-5 (Nov 1 Rain date) for The Clay part and Nov 14 (15 rain) for the firing. $210. - includes 10 lbs. of clay.
evidence_sentence: The workshop page titles and describes it as a raku firing workshop with specific dates for clay forming and the raku firing.
